title: ENTRY BENCH
tagline: IMPROVES SHOE ROUTINE. A COMFORTABLE PLACE TO SIT MAKES THE RIGHT HABIT EASIER.
callouts: 1. ENTRY BENCH: Comfortable seat for shoe removal.
2. SHOE STORAGE: Keeps shoes organized.
3. BOOT TRAY: Contains water and dirt.
4. WALL HOOKS: Hangs coats and bags.
5. COMFORTABLE SEATING: Makes the routine easier.
objective: Create a comfortable place that encourages everyone to complete the shoe routine before entering the home.
quick_win: (30 SEC) Place a sturdy chair or bench beside the shoe zone to make removing shoes easier today.
real_world_action: Position an entry bench beside the primary entrance to support shoe removal, storage, and a clean transition indoors.
game_effect: Makes shoe removal and storage easier, encouraging consistent routines and reducing tracked-in dirt and clutter.
six_s_lesson: Comfort supports consistency. When the correct action requires less effort, people are more likely to repeat it every day.
pro_tip: Choose a bench with integrated storage whenever possible. Combining seating and storage reduces motion and improves flow.
why_it_matters: An entry bench creates a dedicated transition point where people naturally pause to remove or put on footwear. It makes the shoe routine easier, keeps dirt outside, and helps the entire family keep the home cleaner.
best_practices: Match bench height to comfortable seating.
Combine with hooks and shoe storage.
home_quest_challenge: BETTER SHOE ROUTINE CHALLENGE. For the next 7 days: Sit on the bench every time you remove or put on shoes. Observe whether shoes stay organized and floors stay cleaner.
did_you_know: Providing a comfortable place to sit makes it easier for people of all ages to consistently remove and put on shoes at the entryway. PERMANENT PASSIVE BONUS: Improves shoe routine by making the right action easier.

title: CUBE ORGANIZER

six_s_lesson: Modular storage reduces clutter by giving each category its own visible home while allowing the system to adapt over time.
pro_tip: Reserve the most accessible cubes for items used every day and higher cubes for seasonal or less-used items.
why_it_matters: A cube organizer gives every category a dedicated home. It keeps items visible, accessible, and easy to return. Your system stays flexible as needs change. Less clutter. Less chaos. More independence.
best_practices: Store daily items at comfortable height.
home_quest_challenge: ONE CUBE, ONE CATEGORY CHALLENGE. For the next 7 days: Return every item to its assigned cube. If an item doesn't have a designated cube, create one or relocate it.
did_you_know: Organizing by category rather than by available space makes items easier to find, return, and maintain over time. PERMANENT PASSIVE BONUS: Creates flexible, expandable storage that improves organization, visual control, and independent cleanup.

title: STORAGE BASKET
tagline: TEMPORARY CONTAINMENT. CONTAIN IT NOW. DECIDE LATER.

game_effect: Equip this tool to gain its permanent passive bonus for the entire game.

maintenance: EMPTY AND PROCESS BASKET DURING YOUR WEEKLY RESET.

best_practices: Use it for items in transition.

did_you_know: Temporary containment helps prevent small piles from spreading while giving you a controlled place to process items later. PERMANENT PASSIVE BONUS: Prevents loose items from spreading by providing one controlled location for temporary containment.
